brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: There are 4 full bases (piece -1,0,0 / 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 2,0,0) with solid bottom covers and caps on the open side faces, so the cells can hold soil. The drained planting bins were all refused because they hit the pipe (MESH_CLASH), so there are no bins and no drainage.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 (irrigation mode) runs on level 0: it enters (-1,0) through a one-hole cap at bearing 150, passes through (0,0) and (1,0), and leaves (2,0) through a one-hole cap at bearing 330.
The pipe passes through all four cells. The configurator doesn't show any per-cell outlet or emitter, so I can't confirm that water actually gets out into each cell.
check_build found no rule issues and no mesh collisions.

finish.summary: I built a four-cell planter in a straight row: full hex bases at (-1,0), (0,0), (1,0) and (2,0), all on level 0. One irrigation-mode pipe (run-1) enters the west end of the row, passes through all four bases and leaves at the east end. Each cell has a solid bottom cover, and the open side faces have caps, so the cells can hold soil. Each end of the pipe goes through a one-hole cap. All the planting bins I tried, both drained and PVC-bore, were refused because they hit the pipe, so the planter has no bins. The soil sits directly in the capped cells and covers the pipe. The parts check found no rule issues and no mesh collisions.

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
